title: d-CANN: Validation of an international inventory to measure cannabis use in German-speaking countries
summary: The aim of the present study is the translation of an internationally recognized instrument for a detailed investigation of cannabis consumption patterns. In a first step, the original english version of the Daily Sessions, Frequency, Age of Onset and Quantity of Cannabis Use Inventory (DFAQ-CU) will be translated for German-speaking countries and tested with regard to its psychometric properties. In a second step, the psychometric properties will be tested with specific regard to the clinical-psychiatric treatment setting. Finally, a short version of the instrument for screening and/or follow-up will be developed. The study objectives mentioned should enable a detailed and scientifically sound survey of the relevant factors a) frequency of consumption, b) amount consumed and c) age at first consumption.
